statement.notes: 1) 'marketable_securities' mapped from 'Short-term investments'. 2) 'accounts_receivable' mapped from 'Prepayments, receivables and other assets' (current portion) as it is the most likely component containing trade receivables for an e-commerce/tech company. A more precise breakdown is not available in the provided data. 3) 'total_debt_short_term_and_long_term' includes all borrowings and notes: Short-term bank borrowings, Short-term unsecured senior notes, Long-term bank borrowings, Long-term unsecured senior notes, and Long-term convertible unsecured senior notes. Values are listed in the order: short-term bank, short-term notes, long-term bank, long-term notes, long-term convertible notes. For 2024, short-term notes are 16,252 and long-term convertible notes are 0. For 2025, short-term notes are 0 and long-term convertible notes are 35,834. 4) 'total_equity' is taken directly from the 'Total equity' line. 5) Currency is CNY (RMB) as the primary statement values are in RMB millions. USD columns are ignored per rule to use a single currency.
